question:
Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.

You were mad at me for having the same __ability__ as you.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Skill'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The appropriate synonym for the underlined word **'ability'** is: **'Skill'.**
 
• In this context, **'ability'** refers to the power or capacity to do or act physically, mentally, legally, morally, financially, etc.(क्षमता)
 
• The word** 'skill'** is the most suitable synonym among the given options because it refers to the ability to do something well; expertise or proficiency. (कौशल)

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: **'Skill'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's go through the other options:
 
 
• **'Feature'** in English usually refers to a distinctive attribute or aspect of something.(विशेषता)
 
• **'Inefficacy'** means lack of power or capacity to produce a desired effect; ineffectiveness.(अप्रभाविता)
 
• **'Flexibility'** refers to the quality of bending easily without breaking, or the willingness to change or compromise. (लचीलापन)
